checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Silent 9:16 ~15s video with three moving product shots
must.why: 16:9, 5 s, has sound, two shots only.

must.item: White leather low-top, white laces, white sole, no logo
must.why: Red accents, a swoosh-like red logo and a logo on the tongue; the runner's shoe differs.

must.item: Captions legible and visible long enough

faults.what: Wrong format: 16:9, 5 s, with audio, instead of silent 9:16 at 15 s
Shoe has red swoosh-style logo and tongue logo, red accents; not logo-free white
Shoe design changes between the studio shot and the runner shot
Only two shots; no third product shot or end card

summary: The clip is a 5 s 16:9 two-shot sneaker ad with sound and no captions, and it shows a red-accented, logo-bearing shoe, so it fails nearly every requirement.
